title: 第20章 掌握入口，就是掌握未来！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》
content:
第(1/3)页

    九点五十，比约定的时间早了十分钟。

    林川走过去开门。叶知秋站在门外，黑色职业套装，头发扎得一丝不苟，左手提着公文包，右手还拎了一袋星巴克。

    “老板，美式，冰的。”

    林川接过咖啡，转身往客厅走。

    叶知秋跟在后面进来，直接走到茶几前，打开公文包，把里面的东西一样一样摆出来。

    “九州创投营业执照原件及复印件三份。公章。法人章。财务章。银行开户许可证。实缴验资证明——一千万，i今天早上到的账，这是银行的回执单。”

    她的手指点在最后一份文件上。

    “资方介绍文件我重新做了一版，把九州创投的基本架构、注册资本、资金来源说明都整理进去了。简洁，两页纸，不啰嗦。”

    林川咬着吸管喝了口咖啡，扫了一眼那些文件。

    干净。齐整。没废话。

    “走吧。”

    今天没开法拉利。叶知秋提前安排了一辆黑色奥迪A6，低调，不惹眼。

    车子驶过深南大道，往华强北方向走。

    十一点四十五。

    林川推开包间门的时候，里面已经坐了两个人。

    靠窗的位置，一个三十来岁的男人正在倒茶，穿着一件灰色POlO衫，皮肤偏黑，眉眼之间有几分和陈放相似的轮廓。

    陈放表哥。陈维明。

    而他对面——

    林川的目光落在那个人身上，停了两秒。

    瘦。

    这是第一印象。

    比想象中还要瘦。黑色的短袖衬衫松松垮垮地挂在身上，锁骨的轮廓都看得见。脸颊凹进去一块，颧骨有些突出，架着一副黑框眼镜，镜片后面的眼睛布满了血丝。

    但就是这双布满血丝的眼睛，在林川推门进来的一瞬间，像雷达一样精准地扫了过来。

    那种速度不是社交场上的客套式打量，而是一个习惯了高速处理信息的大脑，在零点几秒内完成对一个陌生人的初步评估。

    马化腾。

    二十八岁的马化腾。

    不是后来那个坐在帝国顶端、一言可以搅动整个中国互联网的商业巨头。

    而是一个被服务器账单追着跑、被投资人拒了无数次、口袋里快要见底的年轻创业者。

    前世的记忆和眼前的画面重叠在一起，产生了一种极为荒诞的割裂感。

    林川压下心底那股翻涌的情绪，脸上的表情纹丝不动。

    “陈总。”林川先跟陈维明打了招呼。

    陈维明站起来，笑着跟林川握了握手。“林少，久仰。陈放那小子把你夸上天了。”

    然后他侧身一让，把马化腾介绍出来。

    “这位是腾讯的马总。化腾，这就是我跟你说的，九州创投的林总。”

    马化腾站起来。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Nine fifty, ten minutes earlier than the agreed time.

Lin Chuan walked over and opened the door.Ye Zhiqiu stood outside the door, wearing a black professional suit and her hair meticulously tied up. He was holding a briefcase in his left hand and a bag of Starbucks in his right hand.

"Boss, American style, iced."

Lin Chuan took the coffee, turned around and walked to the living room.

Ye Zhiqiu followed him in, walked directly to the coffee table, opened his briefcase, and laid out everything inside.

"The original and three copies of Jiuzhou Venture Capital's business license. Official seal. Legal person seal. Financial seal. Bank account opening license. Proof of actual payment of capital verification - 10 million. I received the account this morning. This is the bank's receipt."

Her finger pointed at the last document.

“I made a new version of the capital introduction document, which included Jiuzhou Venture Capital’s basic structure, registered capital, and funding sources. It’s concise, two pages long, and not verbose.”

Lin Chuan bit the straw and took a sip of coffee, then glanced at the documents.

clean.neat.No nonsense.

"Let's go."

I didn’t drive a Ferrari today.Ye Zhiqiu arranged a black Audi A6 in advance, which was low-key and unobtrusive.

The car drove through Shennan Avenue and headed towards Huaqiang North.

Eleven forty-five.

When Lin Chuan opened the private room door, two people were already sitting inside.

By the window, a man in his thirties was pouring tea. He was wearing a gray Polo shirt, his skin was dark, and his eyebrows had a similar outline to Chen Fang.

Cousin Chen Fang.Chen Weiming.

And opposite him——

Lin Chuan’s eyes fell on that person and paused for two seconds.

thin.

This is the first impression.

Thinner than expected.The black short-sleeved shirt hung loosely on his body, and the outline of his collarbone was visible.His cheeks were sunken, his cheekbones were somewhat protruding, and he wore a pair of black-rimmed glasses, and his eyes behind the lenses were bloodshot.

But it was these bloodshot eyes that scanned over Lin Chuan as accurately as radar the moment he pushed the door open.

That kind of speed is not a polite look in a social scene, but a brain accustomed to processing information at high speed, completing the initial evaluation of a stranger in a few tenths of a second.

Ma Huateng.

Twenty-eight-year-old Ma Huateng.

It’s not the business giant who sat at the top of the empire and could stir up the entire Chinese Internet with just one word.

Rather, he is a young entrepreneur who is chased by server bills, rejected countless times by investors, and whose pockets are about to be bottomed out.

The memory of the past life and the picture in front of me overlap, creating an extremely absurd sense of fragmentation.

Lin Chuan suppressed the surging emotions in his heart, and the expression on his face remained unchanged.

"Mr. Chen." Lin Chuan greeted Chen Weiming first.

Chen Weiming stood up, smiled and shook hands with Lin Chuan."Young Master Lin, I have admired you for a long time. That boy Chen Fang has praised you to the heavens."

Then he stepped aside and introduced Ma Huateng.

"This is Mr. Ma from Tencent. Hua Teng, this is Mr. Lin from Jiuzhou Venture Capital I'm telling you."

Ma Huateng stood up.
